title: Token to Goal: 3 by 3 Grid Puzzle
description: A flat 3 by 3 board of grey tiles seen from the front and above. A red sphere token starts on the bottom-left square. A raised gold disc marks the goal on the top-right square. Up, Down, Left and Right buttons move the token one square at a time. Hint shows a blue arrow on the token pointing along a move that brings it one step closer to the goal. Readouts show the moves made and the steps still left to the goal.
assumptions: This is a simple made-up puzzle, not a model of anything real.
The token moves only up, down, left or right, never diagonally, so 'steps to goal' counts the up/down steps plus the left/right steps (taxicab distance).
The token starts on the bottom-left square and the goal is the top-right square, so the shortest route takes 4 moves.
Once the token reaches the goal, the game is won and the move buttons stop working until you press Reset.
Up moves the token toward the far side of the board (the goal row); Right moves it toward the goal column. A move off the board does nothing and is not counted.
The start and goal are always the same; Reset puts the token back on the same start. The board has no walls, so the hint simply points toward the goal.
